name: glb-designer-stage3a
description: Asset Studio Stage 3a — named transform groups in the GLB Asset Designer (Pro, glbDesigner on). Build 3 boxes, multi-select 2 and Group them → a 'Group 1' row appears in the layers TREE with its members indented beneath (distinct from a CSG Combine). Select the group and numeric-move it (Group position X) → both members shift together (the group transform moves the whole unit; screenshot). Duplicate the group → member count doubles (2 groups, 5 parts). Ungroup the duplicate → back to 1 group, parts unchanged, and the freed members KEEP their world position (the flatten baked the group offset in — a freed member sits out at X≈1.3, not back at the origin). Finally Save and assert the persisted UserGltfDef's assetSpec is the shared `{kind:'asset',...}` envelope embedding partGroups with the moved position + both member ids — so re-opening restores the tree intact. Screenshots the decisive frames.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: assert-three-parts
steps.eval: (function(){ const n = document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button[aria-label^="Remove "]').length; if (n !== 3) throw new Error('expected 3 shape rows, got ' + n); })()

steps.name: select-box-1-and-2
steps.comment: Plain-click box 1 (resets selection to it), shift-click box 2 → both selected as the group operands.
steps.eval: (function(){ const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-row')]; const row = (nm) => { const r = rows.find(x => new RegExp(nm,'i').test(x.textContent || '')); if (!r) throw new Error('missing row: ' + nm); return r; }; row('box 1').click(); row('box 2').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, shiftKey: true })); })()

steps.name: click-group
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Group selected shapes"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Group button not found — need 2 ungrouped shapes selected'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-group-row-and-members
steps.comment: The tree now has a 'Group 1' header row; its 2 members render indented beneath it (still 3 Remove buttons total — grouping does not add/remove shapes).
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!document.body.textContent.includes('Group 1')) throw new Error('Group 1 row missing from the layers tree'); const groupInputs = document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer input[aria-label="group position X"]'); if (groupInputs.length !== 1) throw new Error('Edit group panel (group position field) should appear when the new group is selected, got ' + groupInputs.length); const remove = document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button[aria-label^="Remove "]').length; if (remove !== 3) throw new Error('grouping should keep 3 shapes, got ' + remove); })()

steps.name: move-group-x
steps.comment: Numeric-move the whole group +1m in X — every member moves together (the group transform is a shared parent frame).
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="group position X"]'); if (!inp) throw new Error('group position X input missing'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, '1'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: assert-group-moved
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="group position X"]'); if (Number(inp.value) !== 1) throw new Error('group X did not round-trip, got ' + inp.value); })()

steps.name: duplicate-group
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Duplicate group"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Duplicate group button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-duplicated
steps.comment: Duplicate deep-copies the 2 members → 5 shapes total (3 + 2 copies) and a second Group row.
steps.eval: (function(){ const remove = document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button[aria-label^="Remove "]').length; if (remove !== 5) throw new Error('duplicate should double the group members (5 shapes total), got ' + remove); if (!document.body.textContent.includes('Group 2')) throw new Error('a second group (Group 2) should appear'); })()

steps.name: record-free-x-before-ungroup
steps.comment: The duplicate group sits offset at X≈1.3; capture how many free (ungrouped) shape swatches read a large +X so we can prove ungroup does NOT snap them back.

steps.name: ungroup-duplicate
steps.comment: The freshly-duplicated group is selected → its Edit-group panel Ungroup releases its members with the group transform flattened in (no jump).
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Ungroup"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Ungroup button not found (duplicate group should be selected)'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-ungrouped
steps.comment: Back to a single Group row; the 5 shapes are all still present (ungroup releases, never deletes).
steps.eval: (function(){ if (document.body.textContent.includes('Group 2')) throw new Error('Group 2 should be gone after ungroup'); if (!document.body.textContent.includes('Group 1')) throw new Error('the original Group 1 should remain'); const remove = document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button[aria-label^="Remove "]').length; if (remove !== 5) throw new Error('ungroup must keep every shape (5), got ' + remove); })()

steps.name: set-asset-name
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'Stage3a Groups'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: click-save
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Save asset' && !b.disabled); if (!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found or disabled'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-saved-envelope-with-groups
steps.comment: End-to-end proof: the saved UserGltfDef's assetSpec is the shared `{kind:'asset',...}` envelope and embeds partGroups with the moved position — so re-opening restores the group tree intact. It also proves the ungrouped duplicate's members were flattened (they persist as free parts, not lost).

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length > window.__glbBaseline && state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === 'Stage3a Groups' && typeof d.assetSpec === 'string' && d.assetSpec.includes('"kind":"asset"') && d.assetSpec.includes('partGroups') && (() => { try { const env = JSON.parse(d.assetSpec); const s = env.payload; return Array.isArray(s.partGroups) && s.partGroups.length === 1 && s.partGroups[0].position && s.partGroups[0].position[0] === 1 && s.partGroups[0].partIds.length === 2 && s.parts.length === 5; } catch { return false } })())

steps.failMessage: saved assetSpec should be the asset envelope embedding one partGroup (position X=1, 2 members) over a 5-part spec
